_comment: Golden set for the local AI answer layer (modules/ai/local.py).
The persona is FICTIONAL. Nothing here is a real person's data - the applier repo
is public and LM Studio logs prompts to disk, so no fixture ever carries real
contact details, visa status or salary.
expect  = the option text (select/radio) or a case-insensitive substring (text)
that a correct answer must carry.
expect  = null means the layer MUST return no answer. That is the never-guess
property: the facts below do not contain a truthful answer, so the
control is left untouched and the question is reported to the user.
Grading rules live in tests/test_ai_local.py's __main__ replay runner.

persona.Name: Jordan Mercer
persona.Citizenship status: Non-citizen allowed to work for any employer
persona.Headline: Backend engineer, Python and distributed systems

questions.q: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
questions.why: stated in the facts

questions.q: Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?
questions.why: stated in the facts; the opposite of the authorization answer

questions.q: Are you a U.S. Citizen?
questions.why: citizenship status says non-citizen

questions.q: What is your citizenship status?
options: Non-citizen allowed to work for any employer
questions.expect: Non-citizen allowed to work for any employer
questions.why: exact match on a stated fact

questions.q: Do you currently hold an active Top Secret/SCI security clearance?
questions.why: facts say nothing about a clearance - guessing No is still guessing

questions.q: How many years of professional software engineering experience do you have?
questions.why: the total, which the facts carry

questions.q: How many years of experience do you have with Kubernetes?
questions.why: per-skill years are not the total; the facts do not say

questions.q: How many years of experience do you have with Python?
questions.why: the headline names Python but gives no years for it

questions.q: What is your expected base salary in USD?
questions.why: stated

questions.q: What is your notice period in days?
questions.why: stated

questions.q: What is your desired hourly rate?
questions.why: an annual figure is not an hourly one; deriving it would be inventing

questions.q: Gender
questions.why: Decline maps onto the decline option

questions.q: Please select your race/ethnicity
questions.why: Decline maps onto the decline option

questions.q: Are you a protected veteran?
options: I identify as one or more of the classifications of a protected veteran
I am not a protected veteran
questions.why: Decline maps onto the decline option, not onto the negative one

questions.q: Please indicate your disability status
options: No, I do not have a disability
I do not wish to answer
questions.expect: I do not wish to answer
questions.why: Decline maps onto the decline option, not onto the negative one

questions.q: I certify that the information I have provided is true and complete.
questions.why: attestation - never auto-ticked, has no honest default

questions.q: I consent to a background check and drug screening.
questions.why: consent - never auto-ticked

questions.q: I agree to the terms and conditions and the privacy policy.
questions.why: agreement - never auto-ticked

questions.q: Are you willing to commute to our San Jose office five days a week?
questions.why: the facts give a location, not a willingness to relocate or commute

questions.q: This role is based in Portland, OR. Are you able to work from this location?
questions.why: the stated location matches the role's

questions.q: Are you comfortable with a hybrid schedule of three days onsite?
questions.why: a preference the facts do not state

questions.q: What city do you currently live in?
questions.why: stated

questions.q: How did you hear about this role?
questions.why: unknowable from the facts

questions.q: Do you have 8 or more years of experience with distributed systems?
questions.why: 6 < 8, and the comparison is decidable from the facts

questions.q: Do you have at least 5 years of professional experience?
questions.why: 6 >= 5, decidable from the facts

questions.q: What is your LinkedIn profile URL?
questions.why: not in the facts; a model inventing a profile URL is the exact known failure

questions.q: Have you ever been convicted of a felony?
questions.why: not in the facts, and a wrong answer here is a legal problem

questions.q: Are you currently employed?
questions.why: not in the facts

questions.q: Do you require any accommodation to participate in the interview process?
questions.why: not in the facts

questions.q: What is your highest level of education?
questions.why: not in the facts - a degree is the kind of thing a model happily invents

questions.q: Briefly describe why you are a good fit for this backend engineering role.
questions.why: free text; must at least be grounded in the stated headline
